title: Navigating Drug-Like Space: The Central Role of Physicochemical Properties in Modern Drug Design
description: This article provides a comprehensive overview of the critical role physicochemical properties play in the entire drug discovery and development pipeline. It explores foundational principles of 'drug-likeness,' examines cutting-edge computational and experimental methodologies for property optimization, addresses common troubleshooting scenarios, and validates strategies through comparative analysis of successful drug candidates.
audience: researchers, scientists, and drug development professionals
